prospective_metric.event_semantics: one complete-support, bounded, multi-channel, de-duplicated RMS-envelope excursion classified as transient rather than short, stationary, or boundary-censored
prospective_metric.denominator: complete inspected intended-silence interval duration in seconds
prospective_metric.aggregation: event count, rate, durations, peak samples, stationary/short/boundary diagnostic counts
prospective_metric.applicability: only the prospectively frozen corrective-02 intended-silence trial
prospective_metric.limitations: functional digital room-fixture-sensor characterization; not SPL, microphone self-noise, or a population event rate

detector.input_channels: all four declared raw analysis channels
detector.even_window_indexing_convention: output center j uses half-open raw support [j-160,j+160), indices j-160 through j+159 inclusive
detector.connected_excursion_boundary_rule: for bridged run [start,stop), censor when start < 160 or stop > N-159
detector.separation_and_deduplication: bridge each bounded inactive gap no longer than 1600 samples once, then classify each connected qualifying excursion once

formal_change: replace run-touch-only boundary detection with exact even-window RMS support completeness
stopping_rule: one terminal attempt completes the corrective-02 cell; every attempt remains retained; a failed attempt leaves corrective-02 coverage unavailable absent separately authorized and frozen failure handling
